brief: `gardenFits()` (~line 3037) is `lawnFits()` plus a pre-dawn landing bound, and after sunrise it returns true unconditionally: `if (hour > sunUp) return true`. So #129's walk-priced-to-land-as-the-light-clears governs only a small minority of growing-season visits and the rest are unbounded at the landing end — the marathon-walker factory the both-ends law names. #148 built the fix for the plaza's families and it is the pattern to copy: famWalk() one definition of the two legs, famWin() the hours the place HOLDS anyone, called by the roll's bounds AND the set-out test alike. Bound the POST-sunrise landing the same way. The courtyard is 15 iterations back and it is the town's namesake.
successLooksLike: Over a growing season x 3 seeds essentially every gardener visit is priced at BOTH ends instead of ~1 in 12, and no gardener sets out on a walk that lands after the beds are in shade.
avoid: The premise number — 16 of 186 growing visits — comes from cue c221, raised at #136, and has NEVER been re-measured. COUNT it on HEAD before you build on it; if it is wrong, say so and ship the measurement, as #147 did. Do not touch the pre-dawn branch, which #129 priced and which works. And do not widen GARD_K to compensate for visits the new bound refuses: the count falling is a legitimate outcome — report by how much.
